exposure: age at the time of conception
percentage of predicted forced expiratory volume in the first second (ppFEV1)
cohort: The study included 56 completed pregnancies of women with cystic fibrosis (CF) from the Italian Cystic Fibrosis Registry between 2010 and 2015.
finding: Maternal preconceptional respiratory function (ppFEV1) correlates with the duration of pregnancy and the birthweight of newborns.
mod_finding: There was no association found between clinical variables or gestational age and the type of delivery, although cesarean deliveries were frequent among young women with CF.
gest_age: Median duration of pregnancy was 37 weeks (range: 31-41 weeks).
